experiments.hypothesis: a ride-sound-only reel (no music, 'sound on' hook) may hold viewers as well as or better than music reels because it stands out in the feed
experiments.successCriterion: hold clearly above the week's music reels of similar length (≥5 pp); otherwise inconclusive — one reel can't settle it

experiments.hypothesis: a seamless swap-halves loop may raise watch-through because replays count as watch time
experiments.successCriterion: watch-through materially above comparable short non-loop reels (≥15 pp); otherwise inconclusive

experiments.hypothesis: opening on teammates' real dialogue with transcript captions (no setup shot) may hold better than text-led reels
experiments.successCriterion: hold repeatedly above text-led reels of similar length; otherwise inconclusive

experiments.hypothesis: mixing in this week's trending songs may lift likes per reach versus last week's free tracks (audio page discovery)
experiments.successCriterion: a repeated, large difference in likes/reach (and reach, noted separately) across ≥3 reels each; treat as observational

strengths: audience: 2026-10-29-first-ride-back (person + contrast + visible payoff, 10.8 s) has 659 views, 63.0% hold, 70.6% watch-through at 2.8 d — about 3x every other reel (analytics/2026-11-01T171611.json; preliminary, one reel)
weaknesses: audience: 15–16 s reels kept 24–33% watch-through vs 47–71% for 8–11 s (n=5, preliminary, confounded with format)
audience: engagement near zero — 0 comments, 0 saves, 1 share across 5 reels
audience: no 7-day window samples yet; 2026-10-31-bridges not in Metricool data at pull time
audience: all previous reels used free tracks, so trending songs are untested
decisions: all 7 reels kept to 7–12 s with a person or voice on screen and a payoff shot
6 reels with trending songs mixed in (2026-w45-trending-songs, historical controls)
user (2026-11-01): not a business account, any trending song OK; test as many things as possible

lessons.observation: 8–11 s reels with a person and a visible payoff have outperformed 15–16 s montages on hold and watch-through
lessons.nextAction: keep reels ~7–12 s this week; re-check with 7-day samples

strengths: audience: first-ride-back (a face, a spoken payoff, hard cuts only) had the best 3 s hold (63%) and about 3x the reach of the other five (511 vs 127-182) — analytics/2026-11-03T000843.json, plans/2026-10-29-first-ride-back.json; one reel, observational
weaknesses: audience: reels are watched but not answered — 0 comments and 0 saves on all six reels posted Oct 26-31, 0-3 likes and one share on 127-511 reach (analytics/2026-11-03T000843.json; mostly 3-7-day samples, so preliminary)

audience: the most crossfade-heavy reel, bike-trip (4 of 5 cuts faded), had the lowest 3 s hold (43%) and watch-through (23.9%) — analytics/2026-11-03T000843.json, analytics/2026-11-01T171611.json, plans/2026-10-28-bike-trip.json; one reel, observational
production: the opening hook faded in from opacity 0, so frame 0 of every reel (feed first frame, loop restart) had no hook text — verified on a test render 2026-11-05 (AUDIT.md R1)
production: ./reels queue could book a slot that had already passed when a postDate was today (AUDIT.md C1, tests/test_posting.py)
production: re-rendering a scheduled reel wiped metricoolId, reelId and history from its post.json (AUDIT.md C2)
decisions: the 2026-11-02 proposal (check warns when a captioned in-point falls inside a transcript word) is implemented with tests in PR lmaccart/cycling-reels#1, together with fixes for the hook, queue and re-render issues — in effect once the user merges it
once PR #1 is merged, talking reels use cutaways (plan-schema.md 'Cutaways') and every reel gets one reason to respond (captions.md 'Give people a reason to answer')
proposals: experiment: one reason to respond per reel vs the Oct 26-31 reels, primaryMetric commentsReach — register before rendering; historical controls, so observational
experiment: shorter caption pages (3-4 words) on two talking reels, primaryMetric hold
git-ignore library/telemetry/ (GoPro GPS tracks; regenerate with ./reels telemetry --force) — the user's decision (AUDIT.md Privacy)
ask the user which accounts (e.g. the club) are fine for Collabs and people tags

lessons.observation: reels are watched but not answered: 0 comments and 0 saves on all six measured reels
evidence: analytics/2026-11-03T000843.json: comments 0 and saved 0 on all six rows, likes 0-3, reach 127-511
lessons.nextAction: give each reel one reason to respond (captions.md); compare commentsReach and engagement on 7-day samples

lessons.observation: a captioned in-point inside a transcript word puts a stray half-word caption on screen
lessons.nextAction: start captioned segments after the previous word's end; with PR #1 merged, fix every 'cuts into' warning ./reels check prints
